system.one_liner: a systems approach to low-bit LLM quantization that speeds up GPU inference with an approximate channel-selection step

content.key_idea: DecDEC approximates global top-K selection by splitting the input into independent chunks and, within each chunk, scattering elements into magnitude buckets, then gathering from low buckets and randomly filling any boundary bucket.

summary: Figure 8 shows the fast approximate Top-K operation DecDEC uses for channel selection during low-bit LLM quantization, avoiding an expensive exact global Top-K. Panel (a) partitions the 4096-dimensional input activation vector X into four independent 1024-dimensional chunks (Chunk 0-3, colour-coded red/orange/yellow/green); each chunk runs its own Bucket-based Approximate Top-K block to locally select k_chunk = 32 elements per chunk, and the four local results are concatenated into the 128-element sc_indices array, trading a small approximation error for avoiding global synchronization across chunks. Panel (b) zooms into one chunk's bucket-based selection: elements are first scattered into 32 magnitude buckets (step 1), then gathered starting from bucket 0 until the k_chunk quota is reached (step 2), and finally, when a boundary bucket such as bucket 9 would overflow the remaining quota, the leftover slots are filled by random selection from that bucket (step 3).
summary_zh: 图8展示DecDEC为通道选择设计的快速近似Top-K：(a)将4096维向量分成4个1024维块，各块本地选32个元素后拼接成128维索引；(b)放大展示单块内按数值分桶、从0号桶收集、若超额则随机补足的三步过程。
